# These synthetic modules test metadata rejection only, never native/public proof.
def bilateral_metadata(monkeypatch):
    # The positive admission object is a deliberately marked harness stub. Only
    # that exact object is classified as builtin here; negatives still exercise
    # the real inspect.isbuiltin predicate, and no image call is allowed.
    def entry(*args):raise AssertionError('metadata stub cannot execute native work')
    entry.__name__='rank_bilateral_run';entry.__module__='builtins'
    original=q.inspect.isbuiltin
    monkeypatch.setattr(q.inspect,'isbuiltin',lambda value:value is entry or original(value))
    core=types.SimpleNamespace(__name__='builtins',rank_bilateral_interface='rank-bilateral-v1',
        rank_bilateral_capabilities=0x1c000000,rank_bilateral_run=entry,get_num_threads=lambda:1)
    wrapper=types.SimpleNamespace(_core=core)
    rank=types.SimpleNamespace(__all__=list(q.R6));nested=types.SimpleNamespace(__all__=list(q.R6))
    generic=types.SimpleNamespace(__all__=[]);rank.bilateral=nested
    for name in q.R6:
        def function(*args,**kwargs):raise AssertionError('tooling stub cannot execute an image')
        function.__module__='skimagexx._rank'
        for module in (wrapper,rank,nested):setattr(module,name,function)
    return core,rank,nested,generic,wrapper,set(q.R6_PATHS)

def require_matrix_runtime_admission_successor(frozen, current, row):
    """Authenticate new admission metadata while preserving old math evidence."""
    assert row['schema'] == 'matrix-Windows-ed4-runtime-admission-successor-v1'
    assert row['original_revision'] == 'cfb5c4036a7b4d523ec1689454a75a5b23f489c2'
    assert row['current_revision'] == '4591b711583fb7a8d51c9af3199e82bc8696cc44'
    old = row['original_utf8'].encode()
    assert hashlib.sha256(old).hexdigest() == row['original_raw_git_sha256']
    assert hashlib.sha256(old.replace(b'\r\n', b'\n')).hexdigest() == row['original_canonical_lf_sha256'] == frozen
    assert hashlib.sha256(current).hexdigest() == row['current_canonical_lf_sha256']
    assert row['allowed_function_changes'] == ['_runtime_profile']
    assert row['allowed_function_additions'] == ['_skylakex_driver_fields', '_skylakex_table_readable', '_windows_skylakex_driver']
    assert row['allowed_assignment_additions'] == ['_RUNTIME_DRIVER']
    # Authenticate the exact static certificate delta before the historical
    # runtime-only projection; do not exempt the whole core allowset from it.
    successor = row['static_runtime_certificate_successor']
    assert successor['certificate'] == 'coverage/evidence/matrix-numpy124-skylakex-certificate-v1.json'
    assert hashlib.sha256(current).hexdigest() == '98b850ec50e0e86f51ae330b183e21bd17820f62babf5af04e62c635258113de'
    comment = b'    # Exact F64 equivalence: coverage/evidence/matrix-numpy124-skylakex-certificate-v1.json\n'
    assert current.count(comment) == 1
    current = current.replace(comment, b'').replace(
        b"frozenset(('Haswell', 'Cooperlake', 'Zen', 'SkylakeX'))",
        b"frozenset(('Haswell', 'Cooperlake', 'Zen'))")
    assert hashlib.sha256(current).hexdigest() == successor['predecessor_current_canonical_lf_sha256'] == '04d4438b7def68598d3dea57e4f2a6c0422053f2b9b1f19df56a90a3465f08b9'
    def project(raw):
        nodes = []
        for node in ast.parse(raw).body:
            if isinstance(node, ast.FunctionDef) and node.name in row['allowed_function_changes'] + row['allowed_function_additions']:
                continue
            if isinstance(node, ast.Assign) and any(isinstance(t, ast.Name) and t.id in row['allowed_assignment_additions'] for t in node.targets):
                continue
            nodes.append(node)
        return ast.dump(ast.Module(body=nodes, type_ignores=[]), include_attributes=False)
    assert project(old) == project(current)


def matrix_pipeline_predecessor_bytes(current):
    """Invert only the accepted v3 C-return observer addition, never its golds."""
    context = json.loads((ROOT/'coverage/contracts/matrix-prescott-v1.json').read_bytes())
    name = 'tests/test_matrix_transform_native_pipeline.py'
    assert hashlib.sha256(current).hexdigest() == context['source_pins_canonical_lf'][name]
    addition = (b'ENTRY_V3 = BACKEND.matrix_transform_run_v3\n'
                b'assert inspect.isbuiltin(ENTRY_V3) and ENTRY_V3.__module__ == BACKEND.__name__\n')
    assert current.count(addition) == 1
    current = current.replace(addition, b'')
    current_call = b'(arg is ENTRY or arg is ENTRY_V2 or arg is ENTRY_V3)'
    assert current.count(current_call) == 1
    return current.replace(current_call, b'(arg is ENTRY or arg is ENTRY_V2)')


def matrix_native_predecessor_bytes(name, current, frozen):
    """Bind accepted Prescott additions before applying the unchanged old guard."""
    raw = (ROOT/'coverage/contracts/matrix-prescott-release-test-context-v1.json').read_bytes().replace(b'\r\n', b'\n')
    assert hashlib.sha256(raw).hexdigest() == '3f7f21eadcddd6afd7730351e3e93f0463ade0dc451416e48512840e6bec4ec3'
    row = json.loads(raw)['sources'][name]
    assert row['baseline_canonical_lf_sha256'] == frozen
    assert hashlib.sha256(current).hexdigest() == row['current_canonical_lf_sha256']
    for fragment in row['inverse_fragments']:
        before, after = fragment['current'].encode(), fragment['baseline'].encode()
        assert before and current.count(before) == 1
        current = current.replace(before, after)
    assert hashlib.sha256(current).hexdigest() == frozen
    return current


def test_matrix_migration_authenticates_full_module_ast_and_all_frozen_sources():
    from matrix_prescott_context import predecessor_bytes
    migration=json.loads((ROOT/'coverage/evidence/matrix-transform-public-assertion-migration.json').read_bytes())
    for name,row in migration['modules'].items():
        old=row['original_utf8'].encode();new=(ROOT/name).read_bytes().replace(b'\r\n',b'\n')
        if name == 'tests/test_matrix_transform_native_pipeline.py':
            new = matrix_pipeline_predecessor_bytes(new)
        assert hashlib.sha256(old).hexdigest()==row['original_raw_sha256']
        assert hashlib.sha256(new).hexdigest()==row['current_canonical_lf_sha256']
        def project(raw):
            module=ast.parse(raw);nodes=[]
            for i,node in enumerate(module.body):
                if isinstance(node,(ast.FunctionDef,ast.AsyncFunctionDef)) and node.name in row['allowed_function_changes']:
                    if node.name.startswith('test_native_'):nodes.append(ast.Pass())
                    continue
                if isinstance(node,ast.Assign) and any(isinstance(t,ast.Name) and t.id in row['allowed_top_level_assignment_changes'] for t in node.targets):continue
                if i==0 and row['allowed_module_doc_change'] and isinstance(node,ast.Expr) and isinstance(node.value,ast.Constant) and isinstance(node.value.value,str):continue
                nodes.append(node)
            return ast.dump(ast.Module(body=nodes,type_ignores=[]),include_attributes=False)
        assert project(old)==project(new)
        require_matrix_projection_witness(row,project(old))
    updates = migration['qualified_implementation_updates']
    assert set(updates) == {'python/skimagexx/_matrix_transform.py'}
    for name,want in migration['frozen_implementation'].items():
        current = (ROOT/name).read_bytes().replace(b'\r\n',b'\n')
        if name in updates:
            current = predecessor_bytes(ROOT, source=current)
            require_matrix_runtime_admission_successor(want, current, updates[name])
        else:
            if name in ('include/skimagexx/matrix_transform.hpp', 'src/matrix_transform.cpp',
                        'src/bind_matrix_transform.cpp', 'tests/test_matrix_transform_native.cpp'):
                current = matrix_native_predecessor_bytes(name, current, want)
            assert hashlib.sha256(current).hexdigest()==want

@pytest.mark.parametrize('weak', (False, True))
def test_line_nd_source_admission_boundary(monkeypatch,fault,weak):
    class Scalar:
        dtype = 'float32' if weak else 'float64'
        def __init__(self,value):assert value == 0
        def __mod__(self,divisor):
            assert divisor == 1
            return self
    np = types.ModuleType('numpy')
    np.float32 = Scalar
    np.dtype = lambda _: 'float32'
    monkeypatch.setitem(sys.modules, 'numpy', np)
    core = types.SimpleNamespace(__name__='skimagexx._core')
    def entry():raise AssertionError('metadata boundary never calls native entry')
    entry.__module__=core.__name__;entry.__name__='draw_line_nd';core.draw_line_nd=entry
    def line_nd(start,stop,*,endpoint=False,integer=True):raise AssertionError('metadata boundary never calls wrapper')
    line_nd.__module__='skimagexx._line_nd'
    draw=types.SimpleNamespace(line_nd=line_nd)
    wrapper=types.SimpleNamespace(_core=core,line_nd=line_nd,_SCALAR_MODULO_NATIVE=(np.float32(0)%1).dtype==np.dtype(np.float32))
    registered=['draw.line_nd']
    real=inspect.isbuiltin;monkeypatch.setattr(q.inspect,'isbuiltin',lambda value:value is entry or real(value))
    if fault=='registry':registered=[]
    elif fault=='entry':del core.draw_line_nd
    elif fault=='core':wrapper._core=object()
    elif fault=='alias':draw.line_nd=lambda *args:None
    elif fault=='forwarding':line_nd.__module__='skimage.draw'
    elif fault=='signature':line_nd.__signature__=inspect.Signature()
    elif fault=='policy':wrapper._SCALAR_MODULO_NATIVE=not wrapper._SCALAR_MODULO_NATIVE
    if fault=='none':q.line_nd_admission(core,draw,wrapper,registered)
    else:
        with pytest.raises(q.QualificationError):q.line_nd_admission(core,draw,wrapper,registered)

def test_moments_benchmark_routes_projection_and_derived_cellwise_checks():
    source = ast.parse((ROOT / 'python/skimagexx/coverage.py').read_bytes())
    declaration = next(n for n in source.body if isinstance(n, ast.Assign)
                       and any(isinstance(t, ast.Name) and t.id == 'MOMENTS_FUNCTIONS' for t in n.targets))
    family = ast.literal_eval(declaration.value)
    assert set(family) == {'measure.moments', 'measure.moments_central', 'measure.centroid'}
    tree = ast.parse((ROOT / 'benchmarks/coverage.py').read_bytes())
    main = next(n for n in tree.body if isinstance(n, ast.FunctionDef) and n.name == 'main')
    route = next(n for n in ast.walk(main) if isinstance(n, ast.If)
                 and isinstance(n.test, ast.Compare) and isinstance(n.test.left, ast.Name)
                 and n.test.left.id == 'api' and any(isinstance(v, ast.Name) and v.id == 'MOMENTS_FUNCTIONS'
                                                   for v in ast.walk(n.test)))
    old = ast.parse('rtol,atol = parity_tolerance(api,np.dtype(dtype),image=data,expected=expected)\n'
                    'error=comparison_error(actual,expected,rtol,atol)').body
    derived = ('measure.moments_normalized', 'measure.moments_hu')
    assert len(route.orelse) == 1 and isinstance(route.orelse[0], ast.If)
    assert [ast.dump(n) for n in route.orelse[0].orelse] == [ast.dump(n) for n in old]
    code = compile(ast.Module(body=[route], type_ignores=[]), '<moments parity selection>', 'exec')
    for entry in json.loads((ROOT / 'coverage/api.json').read_bytes())['entries']:
        calls = []
        def moments(api, image, actual, expected):
            calls.append(('moments', api, image, actual, expected)); return 17
        def tolerance(api, dtype, *, image, expected):
            calls.append(('old tolerance', api, dtype, image, expected)); return 1, 2
        def compare(actual, expected, rtol, atol):
            calls.append(('old comparison', actual, expected, rtol, atol)); return 23
        values = dict(api=entry['api'], MOMENTS_FUNCTIONS=family, DERIVED_MOMENTS_FUNCTIONS=derived,
                      call_args=('prepared moments',), dtype='dtype', data='image',
                      actual='actual', expected='expected', np=SimpleNamespace(dtype=lambda x: x),
                      moments_default_error=moments, parity_tolerance=tolerance, comparison_error=compare)
        exec(code, values)
        if entry['api'] in family:
            assert calls == [('moments', entry['api'], 'image', 'actual', 'expected')] and values['error'] == 17
        elif entry['api'] in derived:
            assert calls == [('moments', entry['api'], 'prepared moments', 'actual', 'expected')] and values['error'] == 17
        else:
            assert calls == [('old tolerance', entry['api'], 'dtype', 'image', 'expected'),
                             ('old comparison', 'actual', 'expected', 1, 2)] and values['error'] == 23

@pytest.mark.parametrize('api', ['measure.moments_normalized', 'measure.moments_hu'])
@pytest.mark.parametrize('shape', [(1, 1), (3, 19), (519, 521)])
def test_derived_default_preparation_metadata_and_copy_boundary(api, shape):
    # Execute the real preparer's control/data flow with a small storage spy;
    # this metadata test neither imports NumPy nor claims numerical parity.
    tree = ast.parse((ROOT / 'python/skimagexx/coverage.py').read_bytes())
    coords_family = next(ast.literal_eval(n.value) for n in tree.body if isinstance(n, ast.Assign)
                         and any(isinstance(t, ast.Name) and t.id == 'COORDS_MOMENTS_FUNCTIONS' for t in n.targets))
    function = next(n for n in tree.body if isinstance(n, ast.FunctionDef) and n.name == 'default_call')
    class Tensor:
        def __init__(self, shape, dtype):
            self.shape, self.dtype, self.flat = shape, dtype, self
            self.values = [None] * 16
        def __setitem__(self, index, value):
            if isinstance(index, slice):self.values[index] = value
            else:self.values[4 * index[0] + index[1]] = value
    descriptor = SimpleNamespace(name='float32', metadata={'unit': 'moment'})
    image = SimpleNamespace(shape=shape, size=shape[0] * shape[1], dtype=descriptor,
                            flat=range(shape[0] * shape[1]))
    def import_numpy(name, *args, **kwargs):
        assert name == 'numpy'
        return SimpleNamespace(empty=lambda shape, dtype: Tensor(shape, dtype))
    namespace = dict(DRAW_COORDINATE_FUNCTIONS=next(ast.literal_eval(n.value) for n in tree.body
                     if isinstance(n, ast.Assign) and any(isinstance(t, ast.Name)
                     and t.id == 'DRAW_COORDINATE_FUNCTIONS' for t in n.targets)),
                     LEVEL_SET_FUNCTIONS=level_set_family(tree), PYRAMID_GENERATOR_FUNCTIONS=pyramid_generator_family(tree),
                     DERIVED_MOMENTS_FUNCTIONS=('measure.moments_normalized', 'measure.moments_hu'),
                     COORDS_MOMENTS_FUNCTIONS=coords_family,
                     __builtins__={**vars(__import__('builtins')), '__import__': import_numpy})
    exec(compile(ast.Module(body=[function], type_ignores=[]), '<derived preparer>', 'exec'), namespace)
    (prepared,), options = namespace['default_call'](api, image)
    expected = [i % image.size for i in range(16)]
    if api.endswith('normalized'):expected[0], expected[1], expected[4] = 4, 0, 0
    assert prepared is not image and prepared.shape == (4, 4) and prepared.dtype is descriptor
    assert prepared.values == expected and options == {}
    assert namespace['default_call']('measure.moments', image) == ((image,), {})

@pytest.mark.parametrize('target', ['wheel', 'lock', 'package', 'reference', 'dependency-library', 'sdk', 'extra-package', 'extra-sdk', 'source', 'runtime'])
def test_artifact_or_runtime_tampering_rejected(sealed, monkeypatch, target):
    root, wheels, site, artifact = sealed
    if target == 'wheel':
        path = next(wheels.glob('*.whl')); path.write_bytes(path.read_bytes() + b'changed')
    elif target == 'lock':
        artifact.with_name('runtime-lock.txt').write_text('changed')
    elif target in ('package', 'reference'):
        (site / ('skimagexx' if target == 'package' else 'numpy') / '__init__.py').write_bytes(b'changed')
    elif target == 'dependency-library':
        (site / 'numpy.libs/blas.so').write_bytes(b'changed')
    elif target == 'sdk':

    elif target == 'extra-package':
        (site / 'skimagexx/extra.py').write_bytes(b'extra')
    elif target == 'extra-sdk':

    family = ast.literal_eval(declaration.value)

    tree = ast.parse((ROOT / 'benchmarks/coverage.py').read_bytes())
    main = next(n for n in tree.body if isinstance(n, ast.FunctionDef) and n.name == 'main')
    route = next(n for n in ast.walk(main) if isinstance(n, ast.If)
                 and isinstance(n.test, ast.Compare) and isinstance(n.test.left, ast.Name)
                 and n.test.left.id == 'api' and any(isinstance(v, ast.Name) and v.id == 'MOMENTS_FUNCTIONS'
                                                   for v in ast.walk(n.test)))
    old = ast.parse('rtol,atol = parity_tolerance(api,np.dtype(dtype),image=data,expected=expected)\n'
                    'error=comparison_error(actual,expected,rtol,atol)').body
    derived = ('measure.moments_normalized', 'measure.moments_hu')
    assert len(route.orelse) == 1 and isinstance(route.orelse[0], ast.If)
    assert [ast.dump(n) for n in route.orelse[0].orelse] == [ast.dump(n) for n in old]
    code = compile(ast.Module(body=[route], type_ignores=[]), '<moments parity selection>', 'exec')
    for entry in json.loads((ROOT / 'coverage/api.json').read_bytes())['entries']:
        calls = []
        def moments(api, image, actual, expected):
            calls.append(('moments', api, image, actual, expected)); return 17
        def tolerance(api, dtype, *, image, expected):
            calls.append(('old tolerance', api, dtype, image, expected)); return 1, 2
        def compare(actual, expected, rtol, atol):
            calls.append(('old comparison', actual, expected, rtol, atol)); return 23
        values = dict(api=entry['api'], MOMENTS_FUNCTIONS=family, DERIVED_MOMENTS_FUNCTIONS=derived,
                      call_args=('prepared moments',), dtype='dtype', data='image',
                      actual='actual', expected='expected', np=SimpleNamespace(dtype=lambda x: x),
                      moments_default_error=moments, parity_tolerance=tolerance, comparison_error=compare)
        exec(code, values)
        if entry['api'] in family:
            assert calls == [('moments', entry['api'], 'image', 'actual', 'expected')] and values['error'] == 17
        elif entry['api'] in derived:
            assert calls == [('moments', entry['api'], 'prepared moments', 'actual', 'expected')] and values['error'] == 17
        else:
            assert calls == [('old tolerance', entry['api'], 'dtype', 'image', 'expected'),
                             ('old comparison', 'actual', 'expected', 1, 2)] and values['error'] == 23

@pytest.mark.parametrize('api', ['measure.moments_normalized', 'measure.moments_hu'])
@pytest.mark.parametrize('shape', [(1, 1), (3, 19), (519, 521)])
def test_derived_default_preparation_metadata_and_copy_boundary(api, shape):
    # Execute the real preparer's control/data flow with a small storage spy;
    # this metadata test neither imports NumPy nor claims numerical parity.
    tree = ast.parse((ROOT / 'python/skimagexx/coverage.py').read_bytes())
    coords_family = next(ast.literal_eval(n.value) for n in tree.body if isinstance(n, ast.Assign)
                         and any(isinstance(t, ast.Name) and t.id == 'COORDS_MOMENTS_FUNCTIONS' for t in n.targets))
    function = next(n for n in tree.body if isinstance(n, ast.FunctionDef) and n.name == 'default_call')
    class Tensor:
        def __init__(self, shape, dtype):
            self.shape, self.dtype, self.flat = shape, dtype, self
            self.values = [None] * 16
        def __setitem__(self, index, value):
            if isinstance(index, slice):self.values[index] = value
            else:self.values[4 * index[0] + index[1]] = value
    descriptor = SimpleNamespace(name='float32', metadata={'unit': 'moment'})
    image = SimpleNamespace(shape=shape, size=shape[0] * shape[1], dtype=descriptor,
                            flat=range(shape[0] * shape[1]))
    def import_numpy(name, *args, **kwargs):
        assert name == 'numpy'
        return SimpleNamespace(empty=lambda shape, dtype: Tensor(shape, dtype))
    namespace = dict(DRAW_COORDINATE_FUNCTIONS=next(ast.literal_eval(n.value) for n in tree.body
                     if isinstance(n, ast.Assign) and any(isinstance(t, ast.Name)
                     and t.id == 'DRAW_COORDINATE_FUNCTIONS' for t in n.targets)),
                     LEVEL_SET_FUNCTIONS=level_set_family(tree), DERIVED_MOMENTS_FUNCTIONS=('measure.moments_normalized', 'measure.moments_hu'),
                     COORDS_MOMENTS_FUNCTIONS=coords_family,
                     __builtins__={**vars(__import__('builtins')), '__import__': import_numpy})
    exec(compile(ast.Module(body=[function], type_ignores=[]), '<derived preparer>', 'exec'), namespace)
    (prepared,), options = namespace['default_call'](api, image)
    expected = [i % image.size for i in range(16)]
    if api.endswith('normalized'):expected[0], expected[1], expected[4] = 4, 0, 0
    assert prepared is not image and prepared.shape == (4, 4) and prepared.dtype is descriptor
    assert prepared.values == expected and options == {}
    assert namespace['default_call']('measure.moments', image) == ((image,), {})

    declaration = next(n for n in source.body if isinstance(n, ast.Assign)
                       and any(isinstance(t, ast.Name) and t.id == 'MOMENTS_FUNCTIONS' for t in n.targets))
    family = ast.literal_eval(declaration.value)
    assert set(family) == {'measure.moments', 'measure.moments_central', 'measure.centroid'}
    tree = ast.parse((ROOT / 'benchmarks/coverage.py').read_bytes())
    main = next(n for n in tree.body if isinstance(n, ast.FunctionDef) and n.name == 'main')
    route = next(n for n in ast.walk(main) if isinstance(n, ast.If)
                 and isinstance(n.test, ast.Compare) and isinstance(n.test.left, ast.Name)
                 and n.test.left.id == 'api' and any(isinstance(v, ast.Name) and v.id == 'MOMENTS_FUNCTIONS'
                                                   for v in ast.walk(n.test)))
    old = ast.parse('rtol,atol = parity_tolerance(api,np.dtype(dtype),image=data,expected=expected)\n'
                    'error=comparison_error(actual,expected,rtol,atol)').body
    derived = ('measure.moments_normalized', 'measure.moments_hu')
    assert len(route.orelse) == 1 and isinstance(route.orelse[0], ast.If)
    assert [ast.dump(n) for n in route.orelse[0].orelse] == [ast.dump(n) for n in old]
    code = compile(ast.Module(body=[route], type_ignores=[]), '<moments parity selection>', 'exec')
    for entry in json.loads((ROOT / 'coverage/api.json').read_bytes())['entries']:
        calls = []
        def moments(api, image, actual, expected):
            calls.append(('moments', api, image, actual, expected)); return 17
        def tolerance(api, dtype, *, image, expected):
            calls.append(('old tolerance', api, dtype, image, expected)); return 1, 2
        def compare(actual, expected, rtol, atol):
            calls.append(('old comparison', actual, expected, rtol, atol)); return 23
        values = dict(api=entry['api'], MOMENTS_FUNCTIONS=family, DERIVED_MOMENTS_FUNCTIONS=derived,
                      call_args=('prepared moments',), dtype='dtype', data='image',
                      actual='actual', expected='expected', np=SimpleNamespace(dtype=lambda x: x),

def test_derived_default_preparation_metadata_and_copy_boundary(api, shape):
    # Execute the real preparer's control/data flow with a small storage spy;
    # this metadata test neither imports NumPy nor claims numerical parity.

    function = next(n for n in tree.body if isinstance(n, ast.FunctionDef) and n.name == 'default_call')
    class Tensor:
        def __init__(self, shape, dtype):
            self.shape, self.dtype, self.flat = shape, dtype, self
            self.values = [None] * 16
        def __setitem__(self, index, value):
            if isinstance(index, slice):self.values[index] = value
            else:self.values[4 * index[0] + index[1]] = value
    descriptor = SimpleNamespace(name='float32', metadata={'unit': 'moment'})
    image = SimpleNamespace(shape=shape, size=shape[0] * shape[1], dtype=descriptor,
                            flat=range(shape[0] * shape[1]))

        assert name == 'numpy'
        return SimpleNamespace(empty=lambda shape, dtype: Tensor(shape, dtype))
    namespace = dict(DRAW_COORDINATE_FUNCTIONS=next(ast.literal_eval(n.value) for n in tree.body
                     if isinstance(n, ast.Assign) and any(isinstance(t, ast.Name)
                     and t.id == 'DRAW_COORDINATE_FUNCTIONS' for t in n.targets)),
                     LEVEL_SET_FUNCTIONS=level_set_family(tree), PYRAMID_GENERATOR_FUNCTIONS=pyramid_generator_family(tree),
                     DERIVED_MOMENTS_FUNCTIONS=('measure.moments_normalized', 'measure.moments_hu'),
                     COORDS_MOMENTS_FUNCTIONS=coords_family,
                     __builtins__={**vars(__import__('builtins')), '__import__': import_numpy})
    exec(compile(ast.Module(body=[function], type_ignores=[]), '<derived preparer>', 'exec'), namespace)
    (prepared,), options = namespace['default_call'](api, image)
    expected = [i % image.size for i in range(16)]
    if api.endswith('normalized'):expected[0], expected[1], expected[4] = 4, 0, 0

    assert prepared.values == expected and options == {}

def test_moments_benchmark_routes_projection_and_derived_cellwise_checks():
    source = ast.parse((ROOT / 'python/skimagexx/coverage.py').read_bytes())
    declaration = next(n for n in source.body if isinstance(n, ast.Assign)
                       and any(isinstance(t, ast.Name) and t.id == 'MOMENTS_FUNCTIONS' for t in n.targets))
    family = ast.literal_eval(declaration.value)
    assert set(family) == {'measure.moments', 'measure.moments_central', 'measure.centroid'}
    tree = ast.parse((ROOT / 'benchmarks/coverage.py').read_bytes())
    main = next(n for n in tree.body if isinstance(n, ast.FunctionDef) and n.name == 'main')
    route = next(n for n in ast.walk(main) if isinstance(n, ast.If)
                 and isinstance(n.test, ast.Compare) and isinstance(n.test.left, ast.Name)
                 and n.test.left.id == 'api' and any(isinstance(v, ast.Name) and v.id == 'MOMENTS_FUNCTIONS'
                                                   for v in ast.walk(n.test)))
    old = ast.parse('rtol,atol = parity_tolerance(api,np.dtype(dtype),image=data,expected=expected)\n'
                    'error=comparison_error(actual,expected,rtol,atol)').body
    derived = ('measure.moments_normalized', 'measure.moments_hu')
    assert len(route.orelse) == 1 and isinstance(route.orelse[0], ast.If)
    assert [ast.dump(n) for n in route.orelse[0].orelse] == [ast.dump(n) for n in old]
    code = compile(ast.Module(body=[route], type_ignores=[]), '<moments parity selection>', 'exec')
    for entry in json.loads((ROOT / 'coverage/api.json').read_bytes())['entries']:
        calls = []
        def moments(api, image, actual, expected):
            calls.append(('moments', api, image, actual, expected)); return 17
        def tolerance(api, dtype, *, image, expected):
            calls.append(('old tolerance', api, dtype, image, expected)); return 1, 2
        def compare(actual, expected, rtol, atol):
            calls.append(('old comparison', actual, expected, rtol, atol)); return 23
        values = dict(api=entry['api'], MOMENTS_FUNCTIONS=family, DERIVED_MOMENTS_FUNCTIONS=derived,
                      call_args=('prepared moments',), dtype='dtype', data='image',
                      actual='actual', expected='expected', np=SimpleNamespace(dtype=lambda x: x),
                      moments_default_error=moments, parity_tolerance=tolerance, comparison_error=compare)
        exec(code, values)
        if entry['api'] in family:
            assert calls == [('moments', entry['api'], 'image', 'actual', 'expected')] and values['error'] == 17
        elif entry['api'] in derived:
            assert calls == [('moments', entry['api'], 'prepared moments', 'actual', 'expected')] and values['error'] == 17
        else:
            assert calls == [('old tolerance', entry['api'], 'dtype', 'image', 'expected'),
                             ('old comparison', 'actual', 'expected', 1, 2)] and values['error'] == 23

    class Tensor:
        def __init__(self, shape, dtype):
            self.shape, self.dtype, self.flat = shape, dtype, self
            self.values = [None] * 16
        def __setitem__(self, index, value):
            if isinstance(index, slice):self.values[index] = value
            else:self.values[4 * index[0] + index[1]] = value
    descriptor = SimpleNamespace(name='float32', metadata={'unit': 'moment'})
    image = SimpleNamespace(shape=shape, size=shape[0] * shape[1], dtype=descriptor,
                            flat=range(shape[0] * shape[1]))

def assert_check_linux_fenv_setup(workflow, sdk_source):
    blocks = jobs(workflow)
    block = blocks['check']
    marker = '      - name: Prepare the Linux floating-point test helper\n'
    assert workflow.count(marker) == 1 and marker in block
    before, rest = block.split(marker)
    helper, _, after = rest.partition('\n      - ')
    assert 'actions/setup-python@v5' in before
    assert helper.startswith("        if: runner.os == 'Linux'\n        shell: bash\n")
    assert 'set -euo pipefail' in helper
    build = 'python tests/util_views_fenv_build.py --output "$bundle" --control-python "$(command -v python)"'
    assert 'bundle="$PWD/build/ci-artifacts/util-views-fenv"' in helper
    assert helper.index(build) < helper.index('PASS_SOURCE_BUILT_FENV32') < helper.index('GITHUB_ENV')
    assert 'assert hashlib.sha256(helper.read_bytes()).hexdigest() == record[\'files\'][helper.name]' in helper
    for line in (
        "'UTIL_VIEWS_FENV_MODE': 'source-built-v1'",
        "'UTIL_VIEWS_FENV_RECEIPT': receipt",
        "'UTIL_VIEWS_FENV_RECEIPT_SHA256': hashlib.sha256(raw).hexdigest()",
        "'SKIMAGEXX_FENV_HELPER': helper",
    ):
        assert helper.count(line) == 1
    assert 'UTIL_VIEWS_FENV_HELPER' not in helper
    assert 'test_join_segmentations_public.py' not in before and after.count('test_join_segmentations_public.py') == 2
    assert 'tools/check_installed_pytest.py' not in before
    assert_check_broad_modes(after)
    assert 'tools/check_cmake_install.py' not in before and after.count('tools/check_cmake_install.py') == 2
    assert 'build/ci-artifacts/' in after[after.index('name: parity-package-'):]
    for name, body in blocks.items():
        if name != 'check':
            assert 'tests/util_views_fenv_build.py' not in body and 'UTIL_VIEWS_FENV_MODE' not in body
    assert "fenv_helper=os.environ.get('SKIMAGEXX_FENV_HELPER')" in sdk_source
    assert "if fenv_helper:common.append(f'-DSKIMAGEXX_FENV_HELPER={fenv_helper}')" in sdk_source
    assert "run('configure',['-S',root/'tests/cmake_consumer','-B',consumer,*common])" in sdk_source
